evaluation_rule.bootstrap: paired ISO-week block bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 0
evaluation_rule.family_multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across four fixed families at alpha 0.05
evaluation_rule.family_target_weighting: equal weight across primary targets within family
evaluation_rule.strict_unseen_role: secondary robustness only; never substitutes for frozen primary

execution_safety.repair_scope: execution-only; scientific design inherited unchanged from V1.2.3

interpretation_rule.historical_primary: retrospective transferability screen, not pristine feature-discovery holdout

model_rule.fold_failure_rule: if either arm fails a fold/target, score neither arm for that fold/target
model_rule.m1: identical strong baseline plus frozen class-C Sol features

primary_targets.settlement_rule: OVER_x iff (home + away of goals, FULL_MATCH) > x ; x is a half-line (no push)
OVER_x iff (home of goals, FULL_MATCH) > x ; x is a half-line (no push)
OVER_x iff (away of goals, FULL_MATCH) > x ; x is a half-line (no push)
OVER_x iff (home + away of corner_kicks, FULL_MATCH) > x ; x is a half-line (no push)
OVER_x iff (home of corner_kicks, FULL_MATCH) > x ; x is a half-line (no push)
OVER_x iff (away of corner_kicks, FULL_MATCH) > x ; x is a half-line (no push)
OVER_x iff (home + away of yellow_cards, FULL_MATCH) > x ; x is a half-line (no push)
